sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Replaces the accent color with the wallpaper color on Android 12 and later, or with a chosen color. A new wallpaper color applies after the app restarts.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hides the AI assistant button on the home screen, in collections and in the reader.
Hides the Web and Desktop app, Blog, Help and Support links in Settings.
Hides the Go Pro entry in Settings.

Unlocks reminders and highlight notes. Adds duplicate and broken link filters, collection and tag suggestions, full-text search of saved pages, Wayback Machine copies and a weekly bookmark export to Downloads. Requires a signed-in account.
